views.front: The rug now has a smooth round textile edge and a shallow sun motif instead of a polygonal disc with folded leaf-like rays.
views.rear: The opposite view preserves the round outline and peach center, with the original ray layout retained as restrained surface relief.
views.detail: Full-size inspection shows the ray outlines as shallow inlays in the thicker foundation. The retained white-on-white default is subtle, so the rays read best at close placement scale.
views.underside: The backing is closed and the circular edge is continuous, without the previous long straight polygon segments.
views.clay: Clay confirms the smooth circular foundation and low relief. This improves the rug construction; it does not claim strong color contrast or a photoreal textile.
